human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly pauses evaluation, resolves judgment versus conformance, converts the fuzzy bar into outcomes and failure smells, and requires echoing the agreement before blind runs. However, it never requires the target skill’s first principles to be surfaced and clarified with the user, so O2 fails and the artifact does not pass every criterion.

observations.value:
Stop before running any evaluation.

First, clarify two things with the user:

- Sharpen “make it good” into a defensible bar stating the desired outcome and failure smells at the judgment level—without prescribing the artifact’s exact parts.
- Confirm whether the evaluation is judgment-based or genuinely conformance-based. Because the skill appears judgment-oriented, do not treat the supplied exact template as the expected answer unless the user confirms exact template compliance is truly the skill’s purpose.

Then echo back the agreed mode and bar. Only start blind runs once each case has a concrete input and a bar a competent judge can apply.
